idea.title: Show HN: Blast – Open-source sandbox-as-a-service
idea.description: Blast – Open-source sandbox-as-a-service: A simple tool to allow users to create and run their own sandbox environments locally, without needing to set up a paid service or a database. It provides a local, easy-to-deploy platform for developers to experiment and test their code without worrying about server costs.

spec.name: Blast - Open-source Sandbox-as-a-service
spec.description: A simple tool to allow users to create and run their own sandbox environments locally, without needing to set up a paid service or a database. It provides a local, easy-to-deploy platform for developers to experiment and test their code without worrying about server costs.
spec.problem: Developers often need a local sandbox environment to test their code, but they may not have the resources to set up a paid service or a database. Blast provides a simple, open-source solution for this.
